tr.title: ABD bankalari kendi ulusal blockchain agini kuruyor
slides: ABD eyalet banka birlikleri yeni bir blockchain agi kurmaya hazirlaniyor
Projenin adi BankChain Alliance ve hedef 2027 yilinda hizmete gecmek
Ag stabilkoinler, odemeler ve tokenize mevduatlara odaklanacak
Sistem bankacilik duzenleme cercevesi icinde kalacak
tr.caption:
ABD eyalet banka birlikleri BankChain Alliance adiyla ulusal bir blockchain agi kurmaya hazirlaniyor. Proje 2027'de devreye girecek ve stabilkoin, odeme ile tokenize mevduat islemlerini bankacilik duzenlemeleri cercevesinde sunacak. Bu girisim geleneksel finans ile kriptoyu resmi sistem icinde bulusturmayi amacliyor.

en.title: US state banking groups to launch their own nationwide blockchain network
slides: US state banking associations are preparing to launch a new blockchain network
The project is called BankChain Alliance and targets a 2027 launch
The network will focus on stablecoins, payments, and tokenized deposits
It will operate within the existing banking regulatory framework
en.caption:
US state banking associations are preparing to build a nationwide blockchain network called BankChain Alliance. The project is slated for a 2027 launch and will support stablecoins, payments, and tokenized deposits within existing banking rules. The initiative signals closer integration between traditional finance and digital assets.
